note: Deterministic — regenerate with `pnpm scripts:index`. Do not edit by hand.

check.meaning: Strict deterministic gate — fast pass/fail, fires on a channel (pre-commit / CI).

audit.meaning: Health / compliance scan — broader, often slower or advisory (soft / manual channel).

validate.meaning: Schema / structure validation — asserts a file or JSON matches its contract.

verify.meaning: Post-build verification — confirms a build step produced correct output.

build.meaning: Artifact builder — compiles source into a committed or served artifact.

generate.meaning: Content generator — derives a file (manifest, docs, index) from source.

sync.meaning: Synchronizer — reconciles one source of truth into another.

test.meaning: Test runner — integration / smoke / unit checks.

figma.meaning: Figma bridge — design-system sync, diff, or canvas ops.
